# Robert Richter

> Robert Richter is a Cybersecurity Analyst in healthcare IT based in Hamilton, Ohio. His work focuses on incident response, email security, endpoint protection, and identity controls, with five-plus years of healthcare IT experience.

This site is a plain HTML personal CV. It has no cookies, analytics, or forms. The full CV is on the home page; the other pages cover accessibility and privacy.

## Profile

- [Home page / CV](https://therobertrich.com/): Summary, experience, key projects, skills, certifications, education, and volunteering.
- [Accessibility statement](https://therobertrich.com/accessibility.html): The site's WCAG 2.2 Level AA target and how to report a barrier.
- [Privacy policy](https://therobertrich.com/privacy.html): What the site does and does not collect.

## Experience

- Cybersecurity Analyst, CommuniCare Health Services (October 2023 to present): Serves on a lean security team. Leads incident response, manages an enterprise endpoint detection and response (EDR) platform, monitors email security, administers Microsoft 365 and identity controls, and runs phishing simulations.
- Application Administrator, CommuniCare Health Services (October 2022 to October 2023): Administered enterprise collaboration, thin-client, backup, and ticketing platforms and supported executive IT.
- Desktop Support Technician, CommuniCare Health Services (June 2021 to October 2022): Managed endpoint imaging and software deployment, mobile device management, and hardware repair.
- Accessibility Intern, Miami University AccessMU Center (May 2019 to May 2021): Ran WCAG 2.0 A/AA accessibility evaluations of websites and apps, plus usability tests with screen readers and voice-control tools.
- IT Manager and Shift Supervisor, Raymond's Pizza (August 2017 to August 2021): Managed all IT operations, including a move to Google Workspace and cloud phone systems.

## Key Projects

- [Key projects section](https://therobertrich.com/#projects): Led technical work on an email security gateway migration, a single sign-on migration to Microsoft Entra ID, and a SIEM log-collection implementation.

## Skills and Certifications

- [Skills section](https://therobertrich.com/#skills): Security operations, identity and access management, email security and data protection, frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks), PowerShell scripting, and accessibility testing.
- [Certifications section](https://therobertrich.com/#certifications): Certified in Cybersecurity (CC) from ISC2 (May 2024), plus vendor and university credentials.

## Education

- [Education section](https://therobertrich.com/#education): B.S. in Information Technology (Miami University, 2021); A.A.S. in Computer and Information Technology (Miami University Hamilton, 2019).
